_cut: Starts 0.62s later than the raw 24:54 mark, past the trailing word of the previous sentence — opening on it dropped the viewer mid-thought. All times below are already shifted for that.
_timing: Every card runs until the NEXT one begins. Ending a card the instant he stops speaking made the text vanish under him, because he pauses constantly — 13 times in 35s. Holding words he has ALREADY said through his pauses is his delivery; what a card must never do is START before its words are spoken. That is the only rule enforced here, and it is what keeps 'and do not grieve' off screen until the verb actually lands.

captions.en: What is the first glad tiding that reaches him?

captions.ar: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ قَالُوا رَبُّنَا اللَّهُ ثُمَّ اسْتَقَامُوا تَتَنَزَّلُ عَلَيْهِمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ
captions.en: “Those who say: our Lord is Allah — then stand firm — the angels descend upon them”
“— of the Garden you were promised”

captions.ar: تَحْزَنْ عَلَى مَاضٍ وَلَا تَخَفْ مِنْ مُسْتَقْبَلٍ
captions.en: — grieve over a past, nor fear a future.
And receive glad tidings of the Garden.

captions.ar: وَكَثِيرًا مَا يَأْتِي فِي الْقُرْآنِ عَنِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
captions.en: And often it comes in the Qur'ān, concerning the believers:

captions.ar: لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
captions.en: “No fear shall be upon them, nor shall they grieve.”
